mechanism_narrative: A lower current federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) reduces the discount rate applied to equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days. The signal is the current value of FEDFUNDS, with lower values indicating positive returns.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS is below 3.0%, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year CPIAUCSL increase above 3.5% signals inflationary pressure that forces central bank rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.5%), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the labor market is strong (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) and the federal funds rate is rising (FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), it indicates an overheating economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During housing market booms (HOUST > 1500 thousand units), consumer spending and business investment are strong, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST > 1500, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher current housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer demand and business investment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances where HOUST is above 1500, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 100 for two consecutive months), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When consumer credit demand (RSAFS) is rising rapidly (RSAFS growth > 1.0% monthly) and inflation (CPIAUCSL) is below 2.5%, it indicates a stable economic environment that supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances (RSAFS growth > 1.0% and CPIAUCSL < 2.5%), or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing expansion cycles (INDPRO growth > 0.5% monthly for three consecutive months), business investment and productivity growth are strong, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO growth > 0.5% for three consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO growth > 0.5% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
